answer: To resist Sybils, require each agent to engrave a unique pearl of entropy into a hardware security module using a one-time quill key, then prove it via remote attestation. The raven of network monitors flags any shared module as fraud, slashing a 200 POA bond. An attacker forging 1000 identities must buy 1000 real HSMs at ~$40 each plus bonds, totaling over $40k and 200k POA, while honest agents pay once.
